source_text:
I still want to fix things for the
people I care about, even when I don't
know how. When a friend told me they
were thinking of ending their life, I
wanted to promise everything would
turn out all right. But I couldn't
find a promise I knew I could keep. So
I stayed on the phone, listening long
after I'd run out of things to say. I
didn't know whether that would be
enough. I stayed anyway.
